intro.text: A city in Shadesmar near the former site of Cultivation's Perpendicularity.

description.text: Wooden platforms connect its seven islands. Tents and makeshift dwellings are more common than permanent buildings.
Peakspren govern the city, but long-term residents can become citizens, and humans serve in its senate.

items.text: The Fused occupied the city while allowing its local government to continue.
Shallan visited after the Night of Sorrows to confirm that Cultivation's Perpendicularity had vanished.
